record.name: Healer
record.description: Healers are masters of Force healing and medical expertise. They excel at treating wounds, curing diseases, and using the Force to restore health and vitality to those in need.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Masters of Force healing and medical expertise, bringing balance to those in need.

progression_tree.description: You focus your connection to the Force, allowing you to channel its energy into healing.

effects.value: Take a bonus action to apply your spellcasting modifier to any one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw of your choice.

progression_tree.description: You have studied the intricacies of the human body and are skilled in medical procedures.
You learn to use your connection to the Force to accelerate healing in those around you.

effects.notes: The Consular focuses the force to amplify their ally's healing, channeling a surge of restorative energy that enhances the next healing roll made by the target within a short duration. The target's healing rolls gain a +10 bonus for this brief moment.

progression_tree.description: You learn to treat the entire being, not just its physical ailments.

effects.notes: The Consular focuses their essence, imbuing a nearby ally with a surge of restorative energy. For a brief duration, the target's healing rolls are bolstered by +20, as if their very being has been revitalized.

progression_tree.description: You establish an empathic link with those around you, allowing you to sense their emotional states.

effects.notes: Your consular's empathic bond with the universe pulses through you, granting you advantage on all Wisdom (Insight) checks against creatures within your sight.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Standing with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a lit staff in one hand and a medpac in the other, exuding an aura of calm focus.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A soothing blue-green glow emanating from their hands and staff, pulsing gently as they channel the Force's restorative energies.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A Healer Master from the Consular Order stands ready to tend to a wounded ally, surrounded by a soft, ethereal light that highlights their connection to the natural balance of the Force.
contextual_modifiers: with an emphasis on the intricate patterns and symbols etched into their robes
in a mystical environment with ancient, gnarled trees and mist-shrouded waterfalls in the background
